Roasting a bird egg whole in its shell like this helps retain water, making the egg a bit chewier than usual.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Campfire Eggs are a type of [[Roasted Food]], and they are the result of [[Bird Egg]]s that have made contact with [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 295}} The roasting process is said to retain water within the Egg's shell, which causes a chewy consistency. [[Link]] can restore one and a half [[Heart]]s to his [[Life Gauge]] by eating a Campfire Egg. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Campfire Eggs reappear in {{TotK}} and are again a variety of [[Roasted Food]]. They can be made by exposing [[Bird Egg]]s to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. The roasting process is said to retain water within the Egg's shell, which causes a chewy consistency. [[Link]] can restore one and a half [[Heart]]s to his [[Life Gauge]] by eating a Campfire Egg. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Bird Egg * Food * Hard-Boiled Egg * Roasted Food }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Eggs, Health Restoring Items, Roasted Food |items= BotW, TotK }}
